train_detection_network: train a detection network using a config file and optional command line options
create_model_with_resume: create a detection model with automatic checkpoint resume from previous training iterations
run_training_loop: run the training loop with logging, checkpointing, and NaN loss detection
test_trained_model: test a trained detection model using saved weights and multi GPU inference
optimize_model_memory: optimize model memory by sharing gradient blobs across GPUs using memonger
